sloka: यज्ञोपवीतमार्गेण भिन्ना तेन तपस्विनी।सा पृथिव्यां पृथुश्रोणी पपात प्रियदर्शना।तामिन्द्रजित्स्वयं हत्वा हनुमन्तमुवाच ह ।। ६.८१.३२ ।।
transliteration: yajñopavītamārgeṇa bhinnā tena tapasvinī।sā pṛthivyāṁ pṛthuśroṇī papāta priyadarśanā।tāmindrajitsvayaṁ hatvā hanumantamuvāca ha ।। 6.81.32 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith killed that woman and said to Hanuman" see this Vaidehi, Rama's wife, cut up by my sword. Your exertion is useless now."
